scope: SCENT, seeds 43 and 44, sEH and DRD2 -- identical to Appendix A1's first two panels
gate_note: The gates panels 1-2 were built with, so all three panels describe one set of molecules. DRD2 0.5 is NOT the 5%-FPR rule (0.345); moving A1 to the rule means re-running all three panels together.
pools: The two arms draw from DIFFERENT sources: best-candidate from the sampled candidates (deduplicated), hub-batching from the enumerated children of its hubs. Pools are subsampled to 4,000 per cell for the artifact.
selections_are_fresh: Panels 1-2's own molecules could not be reused: only 8-71% of them are present in the enumerations currently on disk, which have been regenerated since. Selections here come from a fresh run_campaign.py pass at the same gates.
